## Status

**Unaccepted Phase One engineering candidate. Do not merge or release as Phase One completion.** Supersedes the older workshop draft #15; its failures and source remain historical, not overwritten.

- Source: `b560c696ec06930286d99658ab0205c88dff5f73`
- Tree: `62c0959f65cf122f40caa61dc98f26f906c7783b`
- Immutable local frame: `records/phase1-blockers/freeze-20261017-v1/source.json`, 2,610 tracked files, clean capture.
- Complete original source-bound build is running. Full strict core/imported proof and original complete runtime are not yet completed on this frozen source. Hosted assurance must run on this exact PR head; a branch push is not assurance.

## Semantic changes

- Restore all eight SHA-256 incoming-state feed-forward additions caught by the original published vector. Preserve full transparent replay/conservation equations while removing redundant checked self-equations and repeated bridge computations.
- Exact count/write native rendering and decoding, advancing array cursors, decoded-key member indexing with first-key order/last-value semantics, total malformed-member behavior and validation-before-size node quoting. Count-only escaping no longer constructs escape strings/hexadecimal output.
- Recognize the native constructor's actual 26-instruction/208-byte seccomp input; never substitute expected bytes for observations. Independent kernel observation/authentic custody remains a separate obligation.
- Share source-effective Ada lexical boundaries, pragma aliases, encoding/language transitions and Unicode simple folding between source screening and literal-sensitive contract pins. Preserve the original proof floors, complete source requirements, strict settings and exact existing C boundaries.
- Attach independently retained invocation/acquisition operands before finalization classification. Complete native capture/seal remains authoritative; an ordinary primary failure is not mistaken for materialization failure.
- Replace obsolete call-name audit assertions with actual native consumer and real pin-publication behavior, with owned in-memory mutation qualification. No Python authorization fallback, fabricated custody or relaxed native gate.

## Exercised component evidence

| Scope | Actual result |
|---|---|
| Checked v10 aggregate, original Ada core/fuzz, direct shared-library regressions, filter, 16 MiB text and native semantic smoke | PASS in retained wrapper |
| Native/Python representation oracle | 519/519 matching cases, including 100,000-element array and 20,000-member object |
| Original huge singleton-array workload | Exact 214,748,369-byte output; every byte checked; 138.14 s under unchanged 900 s bound |
| Real primary exit 7 | Before: DEAD / CORE_INVALID_EVALUATION. After: DEGRADED with native COMPLETED/FAIL seal |
| Corrected real failure regression | 1/1 passed; earlier six-pass/one-test-unpacking-error batch retained |
| Final helper source/native/typed-export controls | 55/55 passed |
| Always-complete and late-pin-publication mutants | Both rejected: one intended assertion failure, zero errors each |
| Contract pins | All 464 effective / 1,030 literal entries current; derived by existing helper |

Actual `openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol` internal source reviews are retained and joined by exact source hashes. Their scoped approval is not full proof, runtime acceptance, or independently commissioned F7.

Receipt index: `records/phase1-blockers/semantic-source-cutover-20261017-v1.json`. It binds the published component outputs, source snapshots and reviews. Earlier failures, cancellation, recorder errors, stale manifests and unknowns remain retained. No successful replacement proof manifest has been fabricated.

## Original obligations remain binding

Complete original build/proof/runtime/acquisition/domain campaigns; all intended contracts and faithful callers; automatic nonlimited full-value/implicit Old retirement; genuine protected external admission and original compatibility positives; authentic Luna-high world/child execution; complete original 219-ID/dependency closure matrix; DUAT backup; operator deployment/rollback/soak and independently commissioned acceptance remain open where no qualifying evidence exists. The original 19 acceptance gates and all accepted cases are unchanged. F7 is **NOT PERFORMED** by this run.

No merge, tag, release, install, sudo, production-service change or real-PRIME mutation is authorized by this draft.
